question.text: The equivalents of ethylene diamine required to replace the neutral ligands from the coordination sphere of the trans-complex of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>CoCl</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><mo>.</mo><mn>4</mn><msub><mi>NH</mi><mn>3</mn></msub></math> is _______ . (Round off to the Nearest Integer).

solution.text:
1. trans- CoCl3.4NH3
or

trans- CoNH34Cl2Cℓ

As we know that ethylene diamine is a bidentate ligand and ammonia is a mono dentate ligand.

It means overall two ethylene diamine is required to replace the all neutral ligands (four ammonia) from the coordination sphere of this complex.
